arxiv:2611.34794.summary: Following previous work by these authors, this paper explores all labeled path graphs joined by 1 edge where the labeling contains the information on how to join that graph. The algebraic structure that this operation has on the determinant of the adjacency matrix of the graph gives a finite monoid of matrices under matrix multiplication. We completely characterize the monoid using the representation theory discussed in Khovanov et al(2024).
arxiv:2611.34794.authors: Daniel Pinzon, Daniel Pragel, Joshua Roberts, Zack Marshall, Olivia Strain

arxiv:2611.34835.title: Full Structure Recovery of Linearized Reed-Solomon Codes
arxiv:2611.34835.summary: Linearized Reed-Solomon codes (LRS) are optimal sum-rank-metric codes that generalize both Reed-Solomon and Gabidulin codes, and benefit from excellent decoding capabilities, making them potentially interesting candidates for post-quantum code-based cryptography. Previous works have investigated the underlying geometric structure of LRS codes, identifying geometric invariants that distinguish them from random codes. Other works have proposed approaches to recovering the LRS structure from an arbitrary generator matrix, together with additional data.
arxiv:2611.34835.authors: Valentina Astore, Martino Borello, Alain Couvreur

arxiv:2611.34837.title: The Vinogradov system in finite fields and two-source extractors with arbitrarily small min-entropy rate
arxiv:2611.34837.summary: Fix $k\ge2$ and $1/(k+1)<\rho\le1$. Let $q=p^n$, where the prime $p$ is fixed and sufficiently large in terms of $k,\rho$, and $n$ tends to infinity through prime values. We show that for every $A\subseteq\F_q$ with $|A|\ge q^\rho$, the Vinogradov system of degree $k$ in $2s$ variables has at most $|A|^{2s}q^{-k/2-\eta}$ solutions in $A$.

arxiv:2611.34842.title: A non-Morse relatively Anosov group
arxiv:2611.34842.summary: We construct a relatively Anosov group that is not relatively Morse.

arxiv:2611.34844.title: Quot schemes on projective space
arxiv:2611.34844.summary: We develop general methods for studying Quot schemes on projective space, including a new construction of components with no common neighbours. We show that the radius of Hilbert and Quot schemes can grow linearly with the dimension of the subschemes being parametrized, and construct the first examples of Hilbert schemes of curves with radius two. For absolutely split bundles on projective space, we construct a distinguished generically smooth component and classify all smooth Quot schemes.

arxiv:2611.34846.title: Miyazawa invariants of satellite surfaces
arxiv:2611.34846.summary: We prove formulas describing the behavior of Miyazawa's degree invariant of knotted spheres and real projective planes in the 4-sphere under satellite operations. As an application, we show that every deform-spun real projective plane admits infinitely many topologically but not smoothly isotopic copies. In particular, we produce an infinite exotic family of irreducible real projective planes containing Hughes-Kim-Miller-Nahm's counterexample to the Kinoshita conjecture.

arxiv:2611.34855.title: Real equiangular lines in dimensions 18-20 and sharp fixed-angle bounds
arxiv:2611.34855.summary: In collaboration with OpenAI's GPT-6, we prove that the maximum numbers of real equiangular lines in dimensions 18, 19, and 20 are $N(18)=57$, $N(19)=72$, and $N(20)=90$, respectively. We reduce the upper bounds to paired lattice points in sections of even unimodular lattices of rank twenty-four. Root-system estimates, exact certificates, and Golay-code arguments bound the sections.
arxiv:2611.34855.authors: Valjakas Djaljapayan, Zhen-Qi Liao, Wei-Hsuan Yu

arxiv:2611.34896.title: Weakly Pointed Fusion $\Pi$-supercategories over fields of characteristic not two
arxiv:2611.34896.summary: We study a class of weakly pointed fusion $\Pi$-supercategories over a field $k$ of characteristic not equal to $2$, with unit $\mathbf 1$ satisfying $\mathrm{End}(\mathbf 1) = k$. Assuming the existence of a Brauer--Wall reference category over $k$, we classify these categories up to monoidal equivalence. We show that Brauer--Wall reference categories exist for $k = \mathbb C, \mathbb R$ but not for $k = \mathbb F_5$.

arxiv:2611.34933.title: Invariance of log plurigenera in families of compact K\"ahler manifolds
arxiv:2611.34933.summary: Let $(X_t,B_t)$ be a smooth proper family of pairs with K\"ahler fibres, where the boundary has relative simple normal crossings and real coefficients in $[0,1)$. We show that for every $m\ge1$, every section of $mK_{X_t}+\lfloor mB_t\rfloor$ extends locally over the base. In particular, the log plurigenera are locally constant, and for $B_t=0$ we obtain the deformation invariance of the plurigenera $P_m(X_t)$.
